entities.name: Query Ppnp enzyme
observations: 105-residue protein with Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 spanning residues 12–102 (i-Evalue 2.8e-38).
Shares 66–67% identity and 98.1% query coverage with reviewed Leptospira pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases.
Sequence-based evidence supports a broad nucleoside-phosphorylase function, but exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs rather than experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Q72NZ6
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference annotated as pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase; EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.
Catalyzes reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to free bases and D-ribose 1-phosphate.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: purine or pyrimidine nucleoside + inorganic phosphate ⇌ free nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Specific supported examples include adenosine, guanosine, inosine, and cytidine phosphorolysis; homolog annotations also report uridine and thymidine use.
